image_description: A close-up shot of a slice of chocolate cake on a white plate. The cake is layered with a lighter filling, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a thin chocolate wafer. Dark chocolate sauce is drizzled over the side of the cake and pools slightly on the plate. A small red garnish (possibly a raspberry or candy) sits in the foreground.
